ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 30:70 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels; high-contrast regions are localized at the lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous white pigmentation zones located on the distal ends of both lobes. The left lobe exhibits a large triangular white region containing internal black linear striations. The right lobe contains a high-density mottled white region with jagged boundaries transitioning into the central black mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate 65-degree interior angle and a high depth-to-width ratio relative to the fluke chord.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with variable pixel-amplitude (10-30 pixels) along the entire trailing edge boundary, isolated against a light blue/grey sky background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to acutely pointed lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of white, circular high-contrast pixel groups consistent with barnacle colonization located on the far-left lobe tip and a single isolated circular mark on the lower central peduncle.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct vertical and diagonal dark linear disruptions (rake marks) cutting through the white pixel zones on the left lobe; additional light-grey linear scratches visible on the central dark surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple healed linear rake marks and active barnacle attachments (Coronula diadema) visible on the left-most edge.
other_distinctive_markers: Single prominent white circular focal point (possible scar or solitary barnacle) at the basal center of the fluke near the water line.
